# Q6 -- fillets and chamfers on curved edges (generated by `occt_probe q6`)

OCCT 8.0.1, osx-arm64. Lengths in micrometres. Analytic volumes by Pappus: a fillet of radius r removes or adds the spandrel r^2(1 - pi/4), whose centroid sits r(10 - 3 pi)/(3(4 - pi)) = 0.2234 r from the corner; a symmetric chamfer d the triangle d^2/2, centroid d/3 from the corner.
